<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent_macro "<!ENTITY ent_internal 'Expanded Entity Data'>">
  %ent_macro;
  <!ENTITY ext_ent SYSTEM "external.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bin_data SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top-level comment testing parser processing of comments alongside entities and namespaces -->
  <sub:section sub:id="sec1">
    <?sub-pi target="process" data="param=value"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like strings: <root>&ent_internal;</root>
    ]]>
    &ent_internal;
    &ext_ent;
  </sub:section>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css" type="text/css"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % dtd_subset "
    <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA | subitem)*>
    <!ELEMENT subitem (#PCDATA)>
    <!ENTITY item_ent 'Item Entity Value'>
  ">
  %dtd_subset;
  <!ENTITY combined_ent "&item_ent; and more">
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Comment embedded right inside the root element before any content -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <?catalog-action execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA section with entities inside: &combined_ent;
    ]]>
    <subitem>&combined_ent;</subitem>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

  <!ENTITY alpha "Alpha Entity">

  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc SYSTEM "document.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<database xmlns="http://example.com/db" xmlns:db="http://example.com/db/v2">
  <!-- Comment block 1: describing database parameters -->
  <record db:ID="R1">
    <?db-action query="select *"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw text data with entity references that should be literal: γ
    ]]>
    γ
  </record>
  <!-- Comment block 2: trailing comment -->
</database>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_base "Base">
  <!ENTITY e_mid "&e_base; Middle">
  <!ENTITY e_top "&e_mid; Top">
  <!ENTITY % param_ent "<!ENTITY hidden 'Hidden Parameter Value'>">
  %param_ent;
]>
<archive xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/archive" xmlns:meta="http://schemas.example.com/archive/meta" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment explaining the use of nested entities and namespaces -->
  <meta:info>
    <?meta-control type="refresh" interval="30"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <file> &hidden; </file> safely escaped.
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <file xsi:type="meta:StringType">&e_top;</file>
  <file>&hidden;</file>
</archive>
```

<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" media="screen" href="default.xsl"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (chapter+)>
  <!ELEMENT chapter (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent_one "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent_two "Second Entity &ent_one;">
  <!ENTITY ent_three "Third Entity &ent_two;">
  <!NOTATION xml-notation SYSTEM "urn:notation:xml">
>
<document xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:epub="http://www.idpf.org/2007/ops">
  <!-- Document header comment detailing structure and namespaces -->
  <chapter epub:type="chapter">
    <?epub-rendition layout="reflowable"?>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA region checking interaction with &ent_three; and DTD parsing.
    ]]>
    <epub:span>&ent_three;</epub:span>
  </chapter>
</document>
